scripts.types:check: pnpm -r run types:check && for dir in apps/* templates/*; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm types:check); done
scripts.format:check: pnpm -r run format:check && for dir in apps/* templates/*; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm format:check); done
scripts.format:write: pnpm -r run format:write && for dir in apps/* templates/*; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm format:write); done
scripts.ci:check: npx concurrently --names "formatting","types" "pnpm run format:check" "pnpm run types:check"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "todo-app,every-app-gateway" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "cd apps/todo-app && pnpm run dev" "cd apps/every-app-gateway && pnpm run dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && for dir in apps/* templates/*; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm install); done
